verification_service_identity.identity_method: hash computed by the running process at import time (loaded code), not a separate file read after start

access_limits.rate_limit: none configured (no 429 path exists; ordinary reviewer load <=30 req/min with bursts of 6 is far below capacity)
access_limits.concurrency: single uvicorn process, async handlers; concurrent requests served in parallel; OPC reads serialized per process by design (single-writer lease discipline on the source side)
access_limits.ip_allowlist: none (reviewer egress addresses change; no IP-based restriction exists)
access_limits.what_a_client_sees_at_a_limit: no limit exists; no 429 is generated by this service

note: server-side view only; internal destinations omitted per D-16 (kept in protected server logs). ATTRIBUTION RULE (D-01j): a reviewer fetch failing while this endpoint shows every tier reachable is classed UNDETERMINED until the failure evidence identifies the responsible segment - a green internal health result shows internal reachability, not end-to-end reachability from every external client (reverse proxy, TLS, CDN, concurrency limit, route-specific application error, or reviewer-side network policy can each fail independently of it). The reviewer first supplies endpoint, UTC time, access mechanism and exact error; server-side logs are examined when those observations justify it - this is not an infrastructure investigation of every failed request. Qualifications retained: reachability covers the networks actually tested, not every environment by extension; a cached fetch is not proof of access to the current deployment.
